newsitem.title: USA: Globalstar sets date for rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Globalstar sets date for rights offering.

text.p: Globalstar Telecommunications Ltd said Friday that all shareholders of record on March 24 will receive one right to purchase one share of common stock for each 8.84 shares owned, at a price of $26.50 per share.
The company had previously announced it would issue rights to purchase a total of 1,131,168 shares of common stock.
The rights will expire at 1700 EST on April 30, said the company, unless extended.
Loral Space & Communications Ltd, the managing general partner of Globalstar LP, has agreed to exercise all rights that are not exercised by shareholders, said Globalstar.
